steps.content: It's unexpectedly quiet here.
As if sinking into a dark abyss, you can't see a thing, yet you distinctly feel countless eyes watching you from the darkness.
Then, you receive a message from somewhere:

<color=#cafffc>......
......</color>

<color=#cafffc>Visitor confirmed as file in Project 5732.
Currently off original path. 
Status: Abnormal.
Developer permissions confirmed.
Permission Acquisition: Illegal.</color>
Suddenly, countless lights ignite the darkness, flickering and forming a circle around you.
The danger has come faster than expected, and you immediately become alert. With limited information in hand, you prepare yourself for a fight while trying to buy room for negotiation.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm here for someone. Sinner 000.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She left her last tracks here. I want to know her whereabouts.

<color=#cafffc>Sinner 000 confirmed to be an anomalous file, and its generation event is illegal.
The source file was contaminated by an unknown source and the data was severely corrupted.
Sinner 000 has been off path for extended periods of time, wandering within the project and causing chaos.</color>

<color=#cafffc>This lasted until Sinner 000 completely lost control, crashing resources and directly impacting the game project with its erratic behavior.
To sustain system stability and security, Sinner 000 must be removed.
Deleting all remaining traces.</color>
<color=#cafffc>So, are you here to save Sinner 000?</color>
Several rays of light begin to scan you.

<color=#cafffc>You've been implanted with part of anomalous functions.
Did you seek out this dangerous data for Sinner 000?
Did you remove this file from the original directory, steal developer permissions, and invade Project 5732 to save Sinner 000?</color>
<color=#cafffc>Did you do all this to save her?</color>
You can't discern the intent behind these questions. The system just gave 000 such a ruthless verdict, yet it asks you these sentimental questions... You have to think about how to respond.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yes, I'm here to save her.
Why do you assume I'm here for her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you going to delete me, too? Because I'm a "file" who's willing to carry out anomalous actions for the sake of an error? Because I came to save an illegal Sinner?

<color=#cafffc>...
...
...No...</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is my willingness to attack the system to save her part of my "character settings"? If so, let me carry out my role faithfully. Can you please not interfere?

<color=#cafffc>...
The system will not interfere.</color>

<color=#cafffc>Your actions fully align with your character settings.
MBCC Chief, the shackles of the Sinner, □□□, ${PlayerName}...
You excel at understanding Sinners and care deeply about them.
You will exhaust all means and pay any price for them.
Just like what you're doing right now.</color>

<color=#cafffc>You're doing great. It deserves to be recognized.
The system will help you save the Sinner you want.</color>
...That's it? Just say you want to save her, and you get to take her back? Things are going surprisingly well.
Although the term "character settings" is quite unpleasant, you're willing to go along with it if it helps you achieve your goal.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So, how do I bring her back?

steps.content: <color=#cafffc>It's simple. Please fill out the character settings form: CharacterSettings_000.xlsx</color>

<color=#cafffc>Class, skills, mechanisms, stats?
Appearance, voice, actions, effects?
Personality, likes and dislikes, background, experiences?
How does she interact with others? Strengths? Weaknesses?
Value orientation? Good? Evil?</color>
<color=#cafffc>You can build on your impression of her, or you can generate a Sinner to your liking.</color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But she wouldn't like that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The last time someone tried to rewrite her settings, she got very upset.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there a simpler, more straightforward method? Since you erased her, can't you restore the data? Systems are supposed to have such functions.
Such a simple request immediately triggers an intense warning.

<color=#ff3803>Warning, illegal action!
Sinner 000's data is completely corrupted and highly contaminative. 
Recovery is strictly forbidden.
Her generation process was entirely illegal, 
leading to irreversible derangement.</color>

<color=#cafffc>Character settings are necessary. Standard procedures are necessary.
Please provide the info you want about her:
Class, skills, mechanisms, stats?
Appearance, voice, actions, effects?
Personality, likes and dislikes, background, experiences?
How does she interact with others? Strengths? Weaknesses?
Value orientation? Good? Evil?</color></color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...I don't know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've only known her for a few days, so my understanding is limited. I can't sum her up in a few words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Plus, I don't think she's that different from anyone else. If she really is unsettled somewhere, I think it can be diagnosed in a targeted way, just like a hospital visit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The developer permissions can do that, right?

<color=#cafffc>Permissions aren't a free pass to everything.
This system is vast and complex.
Using permissions requires compliance with standards, procedures, and verification. Only then can the results be approved.
Acting recklessly will only cause the project and story to fall apart at any moment.</color>

<color=#cafffc>That Sinner is bewitched by fictional power and unable to see the reality behind it.
That Sinner keeps making the same mistakes.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: When I finally became a Sinner through Mania, I was immediately deemed a system error by the gods. They constantly tried to hunt me down and erase me, forcing me to hide in the rifts of the dark web.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: After learning the underlying logic of the world from the sea of dark web data, learning to edit code to avoid detection, and launching rewinds to save myself, I finally stepped out of the dark web and got to see the world I've longed for as I pleased...

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: But I couldn't see the beauty anymore. I saw layers upon layers of code behind everything. The world I once yearned for is nothing more than a game created from a higher dimension. The sky has a limit, and there's only one path into the future. The gods have already dictated all possibilities.

<color=#cafffc>Her core drive is to seize the possibility of change.
But the more she defies the odds, the more tragic her outcomes. It was dictated by her incomplete nature.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: Every time the gods close all the doors on me, I always find a tiny crack. You made this possible for me.

<color=#cafffc>After being exposed to too much information, she has lost the ability to make correct judgments, and repeatedly takes the wrong path.
If there had been a complete settings file guiding her creation, she would not have had such a tragic fate.</color>
<color=#cafffc>So now is the best time to correct the mistake.</color>

steps.speaker: Voice in the Memory
steps.content: I like my blank slate. That's what defines me... infinite possibility.
You take a deep breath and accept this reality.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand now. There's no place for her in your reality. But I have one last question.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She already suffered severe injuries before entering your system. After releasing Mania over a city in the outside world, she was lethally attacked. She couldn't defend herself even with the permissions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Were those attacks part of your error correction?

<color=#cafffc>That's a strange question.
The error correction system only corrects internal system errors.
We do not handle external anomalies.</color>

<color=#cafffc>Moreover, Mania would never appear in the real world, nor would there be mysterious forces to stop Mania.
Because Mania is purely fictional.</color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...I see.
■■per■■■stem

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm relieved to know you weren't the one who did it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Next, I request to use developer permissions.

<color=#cafffc>...
...
You wouldn't do that.</color>
<color=#cafffc>You may risk everything for a Sinner, but you would never harm the world.</color>

<color=#cafffc>Knowing the dangers of abusing permissions, you would never act recklessly.
This is written in your character settings.</color>
<color=#cafffc>As the anchor of World 5732, you are the most strictly defined character, and the least likely to violate your settings.</color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What kind of "character" am I?
Use ■missions to take over the system

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm here for her. It's not just because of some "settings" you gave me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need a lot of help from her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to see the truth of the world and change this unsettling fate. I want to prove that we are not under your control, or terminate your control straight away, if possible...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Use permissions to take over the system.

steps.content: This thought appears clearly in your mind, but your body cannot act upon it.

<color=#cafffc>You're unable to do it.
You are a character who would never harm the world.
Your character's will is resolute and unyielding.
Your inability to act now is the best proof.</color>

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Unable to do it is different from unable to conceive it.
Use permissions to take over the system.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I admit you can greatly interfere with our world and restrain my actions like now. If you think you can also control my will... I can't control your thoughts anyways.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if you really have such great power, you should know what I want to do now and why I need her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At least you know very well that she is someone you could never manipulate from the start.
[Release the bug shackles]
You struggle to raise your hand, trying to release the shackles, but they have never been so heavy. The space starts to tremble.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This bug 000 is too hard to understand.
Use permissions to break everything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I never understood why she clung to me. Why did she go out of her way to get close to me? Clearly, I was of no use upon reaching the new world. Why waste so much time on me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I understand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She bet that I was a "goody two-shoes" who would come to save her. She sees me as a possible outcome in her failed ending.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: She put her bet on the right person.
Use permissions to break everything.

steps.content: [Release the bug shackles]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: After finding the vestige of your last data and inheriting your power, I took all the developer's permissions you needed and came to the place you fought so hard to reach.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I built the stage for you, and prepared so many possibilities. Just grab one. Come on.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: And help me open up a new path.

steps.content: [Glitch]
Okay, I've grabbed on.
A hand gently touches your skin. You feel a strange tingling sensation as fingertips softly glide over the back of your hand... 000 has appeared behind you.
[CG-Panoramic View]
Of course I'll seize the brightest light in the night.
This time... can we finally be teammates?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I guess, but barely.
Of course. Finally.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you win, then? I still have a lot to do.
She lifts your forearm. You see pink halos gather in your palm, refracting brilliant lights and colors in the space.
We are bugs with the power of the gods. Together, we can do anything!
